0x00083C.en: 「With my skills now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008AD.en: 「Guh!@ This is as far as I go...!!」

0x000935.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A96.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B0A.en: 「Nngh, so this is where it ends!」

0x000B5F.en: 「Kh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B9A.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000BEE.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000D3F.en: 「This is as far as I go...... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DEB.en: 「No good, took too many hits...... I'm retreating!」

0x000E38.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E76.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EBD.en: 「For the Granzon... to be shot down...」

0x000F68.en: 「Kh...... to think I'd become the shooting star...... I'm ejecting!」

0x00101F.en: 「Owowow...... I give up, my calculations were off.」

0x0010A4.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x001158.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x00118D.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001279.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x0012C7.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013B1.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013EF.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00141E.en: 「I can't go on any longer. If you'll excuse me.」

0x0014A9.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00160F.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x0018DF.en: 「No good, they've gone and got me.」

0x001974.en: 「Those humans have broken through our defensive line.」

0x0019C4.en: 「Hah, as feisty as ever, that bunch.」

0x0019FE.en: 「We settle this here and now, Ignis.」

0x001A32.en: 「Right. I won't let that human near Laki.@ I'll be the one to kill him.」

0x001A97.en: (And even if that fails, I still have a move to make.@ That's why I called Glacies here as well,@ heh heh heh.)

0x001C50.en: 「Cross-check it against the base's structural map.」

0x001C97.en: (Ruina... what trap are you setting this time...?)

0x001CDA.en: 「Captain, the reading's coming from the underground hangar!@ But the map shows no power facility down there!」

0x001D7F.en: 「Then they must have installed something there.」

0x001DBC.en: 「No doubt about it... Glacies is here too...」

0x001E4F.en: 「Josh, don't go in too deep. Be careful.」

0x001E9C.en: (...I can feel it like it's my own. Her heart.@ She's trying... to kill me.)

0x001F0D.en: (But her soul is still bound in that twisted shape,@ and something inside me keeps insisting@ I have to set it free.)

0x001FB8.en: (...Is this my own will?@ Or is it Glacies's?)

0x002014.en: (I don't know... and it doesn't matter.@ What's certain is that unless I meet her once more,@ I can't move forward...)

0x0020D5.en: 「Major Kai, Lim and I are heading underground.」

0x00213D.en: 「Yes... it's something only we can do.」

0x0021DF.en: 「It's dangerous. There's no telling what could happen.」

0x00221C.en: 「That's exactly why Lim and I are going alone.@　And in return...」

0x00226F.en: 「If you're about to say 'leave the rest to you,' I won't hear it.」

0x0022BB.en: 「I'm not going there to die.@ There's still something I have@ to do.」

0x002380.en: 「That's right. In for a penny, in for a pound.」

0x0023FA.en: 「No, 'we sink or swim together' is the one.」

0x002428.en: 「...Anyway, the point is,@ don't shoulder it all alone, Joshie.」

0x002487.en: 「That's right.@ Ruina isn't your problem alone.」

0x0024D4.en: 「Same as at Septempulum.@ We'll clear the road for you.」

0x002527.en: 「This time too... it's a long-shot gamble.」

0x002555.en: 「I told you before, didn't I? I don't mind those.」

0x002589.en: 「Thank you... I'll lean on all of you.@ So I can do what I -- what we -- have to do.」

0x002603.en: 「Elebe 1 to all units!@ Drive the Ruina out of Coiaike!@ Show Melior Esse the might of the Steel Dragon Squadron!」

0x0026DD.en: (I'll find out... what's down there.@ Why Ventos called out to us.@ And...)

0x002773.en: (...what these feelings of ours really mean...)

0x0027A1.en: 「Human, I won't let you reach Laki.@ Spill your blood and hatred before me, and die.」

0x00280F.en: 「Ignis, I don't have time for you.」

0x002849.en: 「Your very existence throws Laki into chaos.@ The impossible is happening.@ I won't watch Laki fall apart.」

0x0028EF.en: 「That's why I'll kill you!@ I won't let you touch Laki ever again!」

0x002985.en: 「I won't let you reach Laki!@ Claw at your chest in despair and die!」

0x0029E7.en: 「What is the source of this drive@ to keep me from reaching her!?」

0x002A46.en: 「Something's wrong with Laki! It's your fault!@ That's why I'll kill you!」

0x002AE8.en: 「Heh heh heh. You'll die here,@ and become fodder for the Officinas.」

0x002B8A.en: 「The wellspring that births our army.@ Though you'll never live to@ see it!」

0x002C08.en: 「Human, you're an eyesore too. Die here!」

0x002C42.en: 「Like my bro said,@ we've got no time to deal with you!」

0x002C9B.en: 「What did you do to Ventos!?@ I can't hear her voice!」

0x002CFA.en: 「So you sense that much... Then, human,@ I truly cannot let you make contact@ with Ventos.」

0x002DC7.en: 「You disrupt Ventos's functions.@ I'll remove the cause. You will vanish.」

0x002E32.en: 「Ngaah, impossible!@ To think I'd be overpowered by mere humans!」

0x002EB3.en: 「As if I could!@ I'm going to wipe out that human!@ Or else Laki will--!」

0x002F2B.en: 「I have a plan for that too.@ Leave this to me and withdraw.」

0x002FD4.en: (After all he said,@ after clinging so hard to Glacies, he retreats?@ Why...?)

0x003064.en: (So they turn me back...!@ Then I've no choice but to use that plan.)

0x0030DF.en: 「I have a plan for that too.」

0x003113.en: 「What about the Officinas!?@ Are we just handing this place to them!?」

0x00317B.en: 「A painful loss for us, true,@ but only for a moment. It will serve us later.」

0x003223.en: 「I told you I have a plan, didn't I?@ Leave it to me.」

0x003283.en: (Farewell, humans.@ This will be your grave. Heh heh heh.)

0x0032DC.en: 「The Melior Esse units are pulling out of the base!」

0x003353.en: 「This is our chance...!@ Lim, purge the Weapon Box Hanger@ and make for the underground!」

0x00340F.en: 「I know, I won't do anything reckless!」

0x003493.en: 「Then what of Contagio and the others...?」

0x0034C1.en: 「Have no fear. I'll bury those humans.@ That's why I am here.」

0x003520.en: (No, most likely we're the ones who'll...)

0x003570.en: 「I'll erase your existence from within me, and from this world.@ You who are fated for ruin, rot in your hatred.」

0x0035FF.en: (Ngh... that's it, Glacies... that heart of yours.)

0x003648.en: (The will to instill hatred, terror, and death@ is pure and clear, yet there's no malice in it,@ no attachment to your own life. That heart.)

0x003733.en: (Ngh... stop it! Your consciousness is crushing me.@ Your nonsense damages my functions. I was made@ this way, an embodiment of destruction.)

0x0037FF.en: (What's out of place is your existence.@ What's wrong is that you are inside me.)

0x00386D.en: (Look at that 'me' inside you, Glacies.@ Look at how twisted your own heart is.)

0x0038D2.en: (The part of you that resonated with me,@　the consciousness we came to share...@　within it, you long to be freed.)

0x003956.en: (That wish became my will,@　and it's moving me now. See it for yourself.)

0x0039B5.en: (Be silent... human.@　I will kill you before I break completely.)

0x003A1A.en: (Gh... urgh...!@　Then perish... die, and to the King@　of ruin... gwaah...!)

0x003BB3.en: (Damn... is his consciousness going to@　break me...!? No, that's not it! Ngh, the@　resonance, the sync keeps getting stronger...!)

0x003C61.en: (No good--not until I know what the@　"King of Ruin," what Ruina truly is,@　I can't cut off the Sympatia...!)

0x003CFA.en: (The malfunction is spreading... I... what am I...?)

0x003D43.en: 「So it's no use after all... Glacies.」

0x003D99.en: 「Then I will detonate this base now.@ With your deaths, I will release the@ energy of the Officinas. Perish and be useful.」

0x003E5D.en: 「You as well, Ventos.@　With the power granted by the "King of Ruin,"@　deal death to the humans there.」

0x003EF4.en: 「Farewell, then.@　May a good ruin be brought upon you.」

0x003FAF.en: 「...The Contagio judged me useless.@　With our death-waves, this Officinas's@　energy will be turned to destructive power.」

0x00406F.en: 「We vanish, and take you all with us.」

0x0040F0.en: 「There's nothing I can do anymore...@　I'm a prisoner of the system.」

0x00415E.en: 「Ngh!@　Hiryu! This is Josh!@　The base is self-destructing! Pull out now!」

0x004201.en: 「This is Ellebe 1! I'm heading to you now!@　I'll stop the detonation...」

0x004260.en: 「Don't! There's no telling when it'll blow!@　Get out of the base, hurry!」

0x00433F.en: 「...You should understand. We have no@　heart that fears death, that fears being erased.@　No sorrow, no anger, no hatred.」

0x0043F0.en: 「That's not true! You have feelings too!」

0x004436.en: 「And yet, I do not fear death.」

0x00445E.en: 「Then why tell us this place would blow!?@ If you'd said nothing, Lim, Steel Dragon Squadron,@ and I would've all been wiped out for sure!」

0x004581.en: 「Why? Are you trying to keep me alive?@　Why would you do such a thing?」

0x0045F5.en: 「I have to do something!@　If my old man started all this, then I--!」

0x004663.en: 「I'm already broken...@　Your actions have no meaning.」

0x0046B9.en: 「They do have meaning! From my consciousness inside you,@　you learned there could be another way to live!」

0x00472D.en: 「What moved me was your own heart, wishing for it!@　That's why I--!」

0x00478C.en: 「I am Melior Esse... there is no other way for me to be.@　What you're doing is pointless.」

0x004847.en: 「...The "King of Ruin's" power is flowing into me...@　Kill me, girl with two souls.」

0x0048DA.en: 「If you kill me now,@ you might limit the scale of the blast.」

0x00494C.en: 「What is there to hesitate over?@　That's what you came here for.@　Come, quickly. Erase my existence.」

0x0049DC.en: 「Why would you say that!?@　You said it can't be stopped anymore, right!? Why!?」

0x004A53.en: (That's right...@　Why did I wish to die by their hands...?)

0x004AB6.en: 「With this girl's Sympatia, I'll break your chains!」

0x004B02.en: 「What I want is to vanish.@　And if you force it, the system won't hold.」

0x004B6D.en: 「Even if you get out alive, Riana... you might be@　swallowed up and disappear.」

0x004BF4.en: 「But we don't want you to die!@ The idea that dying is salvation is just wrong!@ We want to save you!」

0x004CC4.en: 「...That is an illusion born from the@　empathy between us. A false heart, a phantom feeling.」

0x004D3B.en: 「That feeling of yours... it doesn't truly exist.@ Think about it--the source of that feeling@ was never inside you to begin with.」

0x004DF8.en: (B-but even if it's an illusion,@　I really do feel it!@　It's no lie--it's our own feeling!)

0x005608.en: 「They've offered no resistance to our orders,@　submitting quietly to the physical examination.」
